cover_letter_text:
Hello,

I am applying for the Laboratory Technician in Training role with WSP's geotechnical laboratories in Western Australia. Your advert describes preparing and testing soil, rock, aggregate and concrete samples under supervision, in line with the relevant standards, in a NATA-accredited laboratory.

In February 2026 I completed the Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, where my coursework applied AS 1726 and AS 1289 and covered earthworks and pavement systems. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019). As a field engineer in the Philippines I assisted with site inspections and quality checks and prepared site reports, material records and progress reports.

I am based in Melton VIC. I will relocate to Western Australia for this role and can start two weeks after an offer. Full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa), no sponsorship needed. I hold a White Card and a full Victorian driver's licence. Could we arrange a call?

Marc Masarate
